answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose a template-based framework for constrained translation and apply the framework to two specific tasks, which are lexically and structurally constrained translation.
answer_1.outputs: The model outputs are translated sentences with lexical or structural constraints satisfied, such as correct placement of pre-specified phrases or preservation of XML markup structure.

answer_2.quote: We follow Alam et al. (2021a) to use the following four metrics to make a thorough comparison of the involved methods: • BLEU : measuring the translation quality of the whole sentence; • Exact Match: indicating the accuracy that the source constraints in the input sentences are translated into the provided target constraints; • Window Overlap: quantifying the overlap ratio between the hypothesis and the reference windows for each matched target constraint... • 1-TERm: modifying TER by setting the edit cost of constrained tokens to 2 and the cost of free tokens to 1.
